description: Java source file containing utility methods for camera operations in Android, including camera selection, size optimization, and media file creation.

classes.name: CameraHelper
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for camera management and media file handling in Android.

methods.name: getOptimalVideoSize
methods.description: Selects the best camera video size that fits the view dimensions while maintaining aspect ratio.

methods.name: getDefaultCamera
methods.description: Helper method to select camera based on position (front or back).

methods.name: getOutputMediaFile
methods.description: Creates and returns a media file in the Pictures directory with a timestamped filename.
